t: 广古之南燕都城陷于晋朝将领刘裕,结束了南燕王朝.
te: The Southern Yan capital of Guanggu falls to the Jin dynasty general Liu Yu, ending the Southern Yan dynasty.
dz: 广古之南燕都城陷于晋朝将领刘裕,结束了南燕王朝.
de: The Southern Yan capital of Guanggu falls to the Jin dynasty general Liu Yu, ending the Southern Yan dynasty.

t: 阿拉里克国王手下的维西哥斯人开始掠夺罗马.
te: The Visigoths under King Alaric I begin to pillage Rome.
dz: 阿拉里克国王手下的维西哥斯人开始掠夺罗马.
de: The Visigoths under King Alaric I begin to pillage Rome.

t: 维西哥斯人对罗马的封杀在三天后结束.
te: The sacking of Rome by the Visigoths ends after three days.
dz: 维西哥斯人对罗马的封杀在三天后结束.
de: The sacking of Rome by the Visigoths ends after three days.
